---
title: Explore universe
jupyter: python3
---

Exploring the processed universe data:

- `data/interim/universe.parquet`: dynamic top-50 S&P500 universe per quarter; columns `quarter_end`, `ric`, `ticker`, `delisted`, `marketcap`, `rank` (see `src/factor_weaver/data/build/universe.py`)

The membership is reconstructed backwards from the current S&P500 constituent snapshot using joiner/leaver events and ranked by as-of market cap. Delisted RICs have no LSEG ticker; their ticker is the base RIC symbol (e.g. TWX) and `delisted=True`.

```{python}
import os
import duckdb
from pathlib import Path

while not (Path.cwd() / "config" / "data.yaml").exists() and Path.cwd().parent != Path.cwd():
    os.chdir("..")
print(Path.cwd())
```

### Sample

```{python}
duckdb.sql("""
select * from 'data/interim/universe.parquet' limit 10
""")
```

### Delisted tickers

```{python}
duckdb.sql("""
SELECT delisted, count(*) AS rows, count(DISTINCT ric) AS rics
FROM 'data/interim/universe.parquet'
GROUP BY delisted
""")
```

### Market cap / rank ranges

```{python}
duckdb.sql("""
SELECT min(marketcap)::VARCHAR AS min_cap, median(marketcap)::VARCHAR AS median_cap,
       max(marketcap)::VARCHAR AS max_cap, min(rank), max(rank)
FROM 'data/interim/universe.parquet'
""")
```

### Distinct rics / tickers

```{python}
duckdb.sql("""
select count(distinct ric), count(distinct ticker) from 'data/interim/universe.parquet'
""")
```

### Duplicate tickers

```{python}
duckdb.sql("""
SELECT ticker, count(DISTINCT ric) AS rics, count(*) AS rows,
       array_agg(DISTINCT ric) AS ric_list
FROM 'data/interim/universe.parquet'
GROUP BY ticker
HAVING count(DISTINCT ric) > 1
ORDER BY rics DESC, ticker
""")
```
